_README: Labeled web-search result rows for the fused/space-starved-text defect (W3). The four transcript payloads are VERBATIM production output captured 2026-08-21; the fifth is a clearly-marked synthetic false-positive probe. Per-row `fused` is the adversarial agent's ground-truth label, read from the row text itself. `expect_fused_payload` applies the payload-level gate (>=2 fused rows AND >=30% of rows) that a detector must reproduce.
